title: Riding through Iran on a small motorcycle as British person.
summary: Ed March rides a Honda C90 through Iran on his journey from Malaysia to the UK, showing the country and its people. He argues Iran is far more welcoming than the press suggests.
why: Recommended for its heartwarming picture of Iranian hospitality toward a foreign rider.

quote.text: I highly recommend watching this fairly recent documentary about a British guy riding a motorcycle through the country.
